R10 compare gives a relation labelled a computed fact, never a judgment
R11 join compares values only through the caller's resolver for the named space, or the crosswalk's pairs; never raw strings
R12 sort orders by one numeric or date field, ascending or descending, ties in input order; a string or composed field is SORT_NOT_QUANTITY
R13 a sum over rows differing in kind, phase or stage, basis, currency or period is refused by name, naming the values found
R14 the trace lists each step's input rows, output, the rows set aside and why, and the method; the same arguments give the same result, reading nothing else
R20 calc-grammar.recipe.field_shape: a table field of an unknown type is refused INPUT_INVALID, its why naming every type; calc-grammar.composed_quantity: a composed sort field says so by key
R20 undetermined never reads as zero: a total with an undetermined amount is undetermined, naming the rows; unbound and invalid inputs are refused by name
R6 a method other than bio-calc/1 is METHOD_UNKNOWN; a name not defined before its step is NAME_UNDEFINED
R6 any other op, any field not in a step's form, any malformed field, function or code reference is RECIPE_INVALID naming the step and field
R6 every op of the closed grammar, in its form, is accepted
R7 select keeps rows meeting every condition (eq ne lt le gt ge in between, inclusive); an undetermined field is set aside and counted, never coerced
R8 count counts rows; sum totals exactly; difference subtracts; ratio gives numerator, denominator and value; share carries its denominator; a zero denominator is undetermined
R9 group gives one result per distinct value in first-appearance order; span counts through civil-time per row; round is R4's
